newsitem.title: USA: Cordex Petroleum CEO Cavness resigns.
newsitem.headline: Cordex Petroleum CEO Cavness resigns.

text.p: Cordex Petroleum Inc said on Friday that Charles Cavness resigned as president and chief executive office of the company.
The company said it had appointed Ralph Wilkerson to take Cavness' place in both positions.

"These changes come at a time when the company is entering a new phase in which its emphasis is on development of recently acquired producing properties in Southern Argentina and Chile and its Chilean Terminal Facility," it said.
A spokeswoman for the company said Cavness had left the company, but did not know his reasons.
